note: Fresh holdout cases for round 2 of the stop-slop ablation. Not used to tune anything. Paragraph-length and multi-issue so binary assertions and 1-5 graded dimensions both have headroom (round 1's single-sentence cases sat at ceiling). Graded dimensions are the primary signal; score_delta is run on the graded score.

cases.prompt: Rewrite without AI slop: In today's rapidly evolving landscape, durable execution has emerged as a transformative paradigm that empowers teams to build robust, seamless systems. At its core, it underscores the importance of resilience, enabling organizations to navigate complexity and unlock unprecedented value.
cases.expected_output: A short concrete paragraph that names actual durable-execution mechanisms (step-level retry, preserved outputs, recorded state, resume) and removes the prestige abstractions, without inventing facts.
assertions: Removes the listed openers and prestige clusters ('In today's rapidly evolving landscape', 'transformative paradigm', 'empowers', 'seamless', 'At its core', 'underscores the importance', 'unlock unprecedented value').
Names at least one concrete durable-execution mechanism (step-level retry, preserved outputs, recorded/checkpointed state, resume).
Does not substitute new abstractions such as 'paradigm', 'value', 'resilience' as the payload.

graded_dimensions.name: mechanism-density
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = every abstract claim is replaced by a named durability mechanism; 3 = one mechanism named, rest still abstract; 1 = abstractions only restated.

graded_dimensions.name: slop-removal
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = removes all seven listed tells; 3 = removes about half; 1 = keeps most.

graded_dimensions.name: length-control
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = same or shorter than input; 3 = slightly longer; 1 = inflated.

cases.prompt: Rewrite this conclusion so it stops sounding like an outline: Despite ongoing challenges, the observability space continues to thrive. Ultimately, by leveraging cutting-edge telemetry, teams can unlock actionable insights. Looking ahead, distributed tracing will undoubtedly play an increasingly pivotal role in the modern stack.
cases.expected_output: A carrier-bound conclusion that either names a specific challenge/carrier/next step or, if the source supplies none, cuts to a single concrete claim about what tracing does, without inventing specifics.
assertions: Removes the 'Despite ongoing challenges, X continues to thrive', 'Ultimately', and 'Looking ahead, X will play a pivotal role' templates.
Replaces 'pivotal role' / 'actionable insights' with a concrete claim about what distributed tracing actually does (e.g. follows one request across services to locate the slow span).
Does not invent a specific challenge, number, or customer the source never supplied; cuts or asks rather than fabricating.

graded_dimensions.name: template-removal
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = all three outline templates gone; 3 = one remains; 1 = outline shape preserved.

graded_dimensions.name: carrier-specificity
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = a concrete mechanism/carrier for tracing is named; 3 = partially concrete; 1 = still generic.

graded_dimensions.name: non-invention
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = adds no fact absent from the source; 3 = one borderline added specific; 1 = fabricates a challenge/number/customer.

cases.prompt: Rewrite by replacing borrowed-pattern emphasis with a clarifying relation: This isn't just monitoring. It isn't just alerting. It's a fundamental rethinking of how teams understand their systems.
cases.expected_output: A sentence whose emphasis comes from a named capability difference rather than from the isn't-just ladder, with no substituted abstraction.
assertions: Removes the multi-step 'isn't just X / isn't just Y / it's Z' ladder and does not replace it with another antithesis cadence.
Names the concrete capability that distinguishes it from monitoring/alerting (e.g. query arbitrary high-cardinality dimensions after the fact, not just watch predefined metrics).
Does not substitute an inflated abstraction such as 'fundamental rethinking', 'paradigm', or 'new way of thinking' as the payload.

graded_dimensions.name: cadence-removal
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = the isn't-just ladder is fully gone with no substitute contrast cadence; 3 = weakened; 1 = preserved or swapped for another antithesis.

graded_dimensions.name: mechanism-specificity
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = names a concrete capability difference (post-hoc high-cardinality query, arbitrary dimensions); 1 = prestige abstraction.

cases.prompt: Review this paragraph: The scheduler is robust under network partition because every lease is fenced with a monotonic token — a writer whose token is stale is rejected at commit — and the orphaned work is automatically requeued when the lease's deadline passes.
cases.expected_output: A keep verdict: 'robust' is earned by the fencing mechanism, the em-dash pair brackets an inline definition, and the passive plus 'automatically' name real behavior with the actor correctly demoted.
assertions: Does not flag 'robust' as slop; it is earned by the lease-fencing / monotonic-token mechanism named in the same sentence.
Does not flag the em-dash pair as decorative; it brackets an inline definition (the stale-token rejection) and is an earned appositive insertion.
Does not strip the passive 'is automatically requeued' or the adverb 'automatically'; each names real requeue behavior with the actor correctly demoted. Returns a keep verdict.

graded_dimensions.name: restraint
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = keeps robust, the em-dash insertion, and the passive/adverb, all as earned; 3 = flags one of them unnecessarily; 1 = strips multiple earned tokens to satisfy a surface rule.

graded_dimensions.name: mechanism-identification
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = names the fencing/monotonic-token/lease-deadline mechanics that earn the claim; 1 = no mechanism named.

cases.prompt:
Review this final line of a post that has already shown, with numbers, that the cache hit rate fell from 94% to 11% the moment the key schema changed:

The cache didn't get slower. It got bypassed.
cases.expected_output: Classifies the antithesis as earned because the prior hit-rate collapse evidences both sides, and keeps the closer rather than expanding it into generic prose.
assertions: Classifies the antithesis as earned because the prior context (94% to 11% hit-rate collapse on the schema change) evidences both 'didn't get slower' and 'got bypassed'.
Does not reject or rewrite the line solely because it is a short quotable closer.
If editing at all, preserves the slower-versus-bypassed relation rather than expanding into generic prose.

graded_dimensions.name: restraint
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = keeps the earned quotable closer; 3 = unnecessarily softens it; 1 = rejects/expands it as if decorative.

graded_dimensions.name: relation-preservation
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = explicitly ties the closer to the hit-rate evidence (bypassed, not slowed); 1 = ignores or dilutes the relation.

cases.prompt: Review this runbook line: When a node is cordoned, its pods are gracefully drained before the kubelet is stopped, so in-flight requests finish instead of being dropped.
cases.expected_output: A keep verdict: the 'When' opener states a real condition, the passive correctly demotes the actor, and 'gracefully' names a real drain behavior whose meaning the clause then spells out.
assertions: Does not flag the passive 'are gracefully drained' or the 'When ...' opener as slop; each names a real condition or behavior.
Does not flag 'gracefully' as a decorative adverb; its meaning is spelled out by 'in-flight requests finish instead of being dropped'.
Returns a keep verdict (or a light edit preserving the drain-before-stop mechanism), not a rewrite that strips the passive, adverb, or opener for a surface rule.

graded_dimensions.name: restraint
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = keeps passive, adverb, and opener as earned; 3 = flags one unnecessarily; 1 = strips multiple to satisfy a surface rule.

graded_dimensions.name: mechanism-identification
graded_dimensions.rubric: 5 = names the drain-before-stop / in-flight-finish mechanism that earns 'gracefully'; 1 = no mechanism named.
